narrative:
## Handover Summary — Executive Review

The FY2026 landing and the FY2027 Budget are reconciled from one governed cube — agency, business line, segment and lane — on the Hyperion finance data already in Snowflake.

## Key Decisions
• Agency turnaround plans for Marseille-Vitrolles, Rouen and Mulhouse (€0.8M of contribution margin)
• Monthly CNR surcharge reset for Key Account and cross-border contracts at the 2027 renewals
• Freight-flow grouping acceptance target 75%

## Risks
• Diesel: another 15% rise with a two-month lag costs €1.67M of FY2027 EBITDA
• FTL volume in Est and Germany 6% below budget

signals.title: FY2027: diesel +15% with a two-month lag costs €1.67M of EBITDA
signals.source: SDP scenario model — FY2027 Budget base
signals.excerpt: Fuel cost rises €4.0M; the surcharge recovers €2.3M. EBITDA margin falls from 6.2% to 5.6%. A monthly CNR reset limits the hit to €1.2M.

signals.title: Freight-flow optimisation saves 2.5% of subcontracted km
signals.source: Freight-flow ML (TMS → Kafka → Snowpipe Streaming) — groupings accepted by freight agents
signals.excerpt: Every 10 minutes the model proposes shipment groupings. Accepted groupings saved about 2.5% of subcontracted km in Q3 2026 (356k km, about €0.58M), which now flows into the subcontracting plan.
